1b1(rgyud): @#//rgya gar skad du/sarba d+harma ma hA san ti bo d+hi tsid ta ku la ya rA dza/bod skad du/chos 
1b2(rgyud): thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po//bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems kun 
1b3(rgyud): byed rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bshad pa'i dus na/'og min gyi gnas chos nyid kyi mkha' 
1b4(rgyud): dbyings nyid kyi klong sems nyid kyi gnas ye shes sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i/gzhal yas khang na nyid 
1b5(rgyud): kyi rang bzhin dang /nyid kyi ngo bo dang /nyid kyi thugs rje ye shes mngon du phyung ba'i 'khor 'di lta ste/
1b6(rgyud): nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi 'khor chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 
1b7(rgyud): sku sa zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longasaspyod rdzogs pa'i sku chu zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang nyid kyi ngo bo'i 
1b8(rgyud): 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i+i sku me zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /
1b9(rgyud): nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longsspyod rdzogs 
2a1(rgyud): @#//pa'i sku rlung zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /gzhan yang thugs rje ye shes mngon du phyung ba'i sprul pa'i 'khor 'di lta 
2a2(rgyud): ste/'dod pa'i khams kyi sems can zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang/gzugs kyi khams kyi sems can zhes ba'i 'khor dang /gzugs med pa'i khams kyi sems cad zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang gzhan yang nyid 
2a3(rgyud): kyi rang bzhin la lta ba'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi 'di lta ste/shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang yongs su rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 'khaur dang /rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang sems dpa'i 
2a4(rgyud): rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 'chor dang /nyid kyi rang bzhin dang /nyid kyi ngo bo dang /nyid kyi thugs rje rang bzhin 'byed pa mi mnga' bas thabs gcig go/gzhan yang nyid kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i 'khor 'di lta ste/
2a5(rgyud): sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la gnas pa'i 'khor dang /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis don mdzad pa'i 'khor dang /slad nas byon pa'i sangs rgyas nyid las 'byung ba'i 'khor dang /'byed pa mi mnga' 
2a6(rgyud): ba'i rang bzhin gyis thabs gcig par bzhugs so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des 'khor thams cad nyid kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir 'khor thams cad nyid kyis sems nyid kyi thugs 
2a7(rgyud): la thim par mdzad do//rang 'byung gi ye shes gsal bar mdzad do//de nas thams cad chos nyid du ldan par bya ba'i phyir thams cad bsdus nas thig le chen po gcig tu bzhugs so//de nas sems dpa' de nyid kyi 
2a8(rgyud): rang bzhin thig le chen po gcig tu gzhugs pa de las byung nas byang chub kyi sems kyang byed rgyal po'i spyan sngar dga' ba'i sems kyis dang ba'i mdangs phyung ste 'khod pas byang chub kyi sems kun byad rgyal 
2b1(rgyud): pos sems dpa' rdo rje la smras pa/sems dpa' rdo rje e ma ho//dga' ba'i sems skyes e ma ho//dad pa'i mdangs phyung e ma ho//nga las byung ba e ma ho//zhes gsungs pas/de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/
2b2(rgyud): kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//ston pa nyid kyang thig le spros med dam//'khor rnams kun kyang thig le spros med dam //bstan pa kun kyang thig le spros meddam//dus dang gnas kyang thig le spros med dang //
2b3(rgyud): thams cad kun kyang thig le rang bzhin na//ston pa'i ston pas ci zhig ston par mdzad//'khor du 'khor ba'i don ni ci la 'khor//'khor la ston pa ci zhig ston par byed//dus dang gnas ni gcig pa ji lta bu zhes zhus
2b4(rgyud): so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des sems dpa' rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po yid sgra la phyug gcig/ngas don sgrar bshad kyis/kye sems dpa' chen po//
2b5(rgyud): sems nyid kun byed rgyal po nga nyid ni//chos rnams thams cad kun gyi snying po ste//snying po ma spros ye nas thig le yin//thig le ye nas spros pa med pa'i don//ston pa dang ni bstan pa 'khor dus gnas//
2b6(rgyud): nga las byung bas ye nas thig le ste/nga yi rang bzhin thig le bstan pa yin zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed/rgyal po las gleng bzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o////de nas byang chub kyi semskun byed
2b7(rgyud): rgyal po nges chos thams cad nyid las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba la gnas par mdzad do//de nas 'khor gyi rang bzhin las sems dpa' rdo rje langs nas ston pa byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po'i
2b8(rgyud): bar du gnangs phyung ste 'khod nas zhus pa/kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//khyod kyi 'khor du bdag 'dus 'khod pa de//bdag ni 'tshal ba'i don ni ci zhig mchis//bdag 'tshal don ni khyod
3a1(rgyud): @#//kyis bstan du gsol zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi rang bzhin dang /nyid kyi ngo bo dang /nyid kyi thugs rje las chos thams cad bkod pa ni nyid kyi rang 'byung gi ye 
3a2(rgyud): shes chen po gcig las rang 'byung gi ye shes chen po lnga phyung pa ni 'di lta ste/zhe sdang rang byung ye shes chen po dang /'dod chags rang 'byung ye shes chen po dang/gti mug rang 'byung ye shes chen pa dang/phrag dog
3a3(rgyud): rang 'byung ye shes chen po ngang/nga rgyal rang 'byung ye shes chen bo dang/rang 'byung gi ye shes lnga pa des rgyan gyi rgyu chen po lnga ni phyung /'jig cing rten pa'i khams chen po gsum ni bkod de rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus
3a4(rgyud): lnga gcig tu blangs pa 'di lta ste/rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus sa zhes bya ba'i lus dang/rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus chu zhes bya ba'i lus dang /rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus me zhes bya ba'i lus dang//rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus rlung zhes bya ba'i lus dang//
3a5(rgyud): rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i lus la gcig tu lus thams cad blangs/ye shes lnga'i rigs so sor phye ste/rang 'byung ye shes zhe sdang gi rigs dang /rang 'byung ye shes 'dod chags kyi rigs dang/
3a6(rgyud): rang 'byung ye shes gti mug gi rigs dang/rang 'byung ye shes phrag dog gi rigs dang/rang 'byang ye shes nga rgyal gyi rigs dang/rang 'byung yeshes lnga'i rigs lus rgyan kyi lus can gyi chos nyid bkod do//
3a7(rgyud): byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po de nyid kyang nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi chos nyid bkod pa de bzhin du bzhugs so//de nas sems dpa' rdo rje de byang chub kyi sems kun byedargyal po'i spyan sngar yang 'dug
3a8(rgyud): nas/kye ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//nyid kyi thugs gcig rang 'byung ye shes las//rang 'byung ye shes rnam pa lnga byung nas//de las rgyan gyi rgyu lnga byung nas ni//ye shes lnga yi lus lnga blangs 
3b1(rgyud): pa 'dis//kun byed rgyal po'i dgos pa ci zhig che zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des slar gsungs pa/kye sems dpa' chen po dgos pa ni//kun byed rgyal po byed mkhan nga
3b2(rgyud): las ni//ma gtogs pa yi byed mkhan gzhan na med//chos nyid byed pa yang ni nga las med//ston pa gsum yang 'god pa nga las med//'khor gyi tshogs yang 'god pa nga las med //de bzhin chos nyid
3b3(rgyud): 'god pa nga las med//sems dpa' rdo rje khyod la nga yis ni//nga yi rang bzhin khyod la bstan par bya//nga la rang bzhin rnam pa gsum yod de//nga yi rang bzhin byang chub sems yin no//byang ba dag gi rang
3b4(rgyud): bzhin bstan pa ni//phun sum tshogs pa rnam gsum chos nyid byang//chub pa dag gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni//dgos pa tshogs pa rnam pa gsum gyis ni//nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab par gnas//
3b5(rgyud): sems shes bya ba'i rang bzhin bstan pa ni/mi 'gag ma lus kun byed rgyal po ste//kun byas byang chub sems su ma lus byas shes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems sun byed rgyal po las chos nyid
3b6(rgyud): mngon du phyung nas bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi sngon rol du byed pa po nga byung ba 'di gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen
3b7(rgyud): po yid rna dbang la zhugs cig/rna dbang sgra la rtogs shig/kye nga ni kun byed rgyal po ste//nga ni kun byed byang chub sems//nga med pa yi sngon rol na//chos rnams 'byung ba'i snying po med//nga med pa yi
3b8(rgyud): sngon rol na//chos kun byed pa'i rgyal po med//nga med pa yi sngon ro la na//ston pa bya ba ye nas med//nga med pa yi sdon rol na//bstan pa bya ba ye nas med//nga med pa yi sngon rol na //'khor zhes bya ba
4a1(rgyud): @#//ye nas med//sems dpa' rdo rje rtog ma skye//sems dpa' chen po khyod nyid kyang //nga yi ngo bo sprul pa yin zhes gsungs so//de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes byang chub kyi sems kun byed 
4a2(rgyud): rgyal po la zhus pa//kye kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems//khyod ni ye nas chen po yin//ston pa dang ni bstan pa dang //'khor la sogs pa'i chos rnams kun//byed mkhan khyod kyis byas pas na//ji ltar 
4a3(rgyud): snang ba'i chos rnams kun//byed pa mkhan khyod kyis byas par snang //ston pa gcig gam rnam pa du ru yod//bstan pa gcig gam rnam pa ngu ru yod//'khor rnams gcig gam rnam pa ngu du yod ces zhus so//
4a4(rgyud): de nas byang chub kyi sems kun gyi rgyal pos slar gsungs pa//kye rang 'byung ye shes kun gyi ston par gcig/nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum snang ba la//ston pa'i grangs ni rnam pa gsum du byung //nga ni 
4a5(rgyud): de bzhin nyid du gcig pa las//chos rnams kun gyi chos nyid de bzhin nyid//nga nyid byang chub sems las gzhan med do//nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis//'khor la bstan pa rnam pa gsum du bstan//
4a6(rgyud): nga yi ngo bo gcig tu phyung nas ni//nga yi rang bzhin gcig tu bstan pa'i phyir//kun byed nga yi 'khor du kun kyang gcig/nga las byung ba'i ston ba sku gsum gyis//'khor gyi bye brag rnam pa gsum du yod ces//
4a7(rgyud): gsungs so//sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa//kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//khyod las byung ba'i ston pa sku bsum gyis//khyod sar 'gro ba'i lam ni yod dam med//med na khyod kyis sa ru 
4a8(rgyud): byin gyis byin//yod na bgrod nas phyin nam ma bgrod phyin//kye sems dpa' chen po nyon gcig/nga las byung ba'i rton pa sku gsum la//nga yi sa ru bgrod ba'i lam med de//nga yi rang 'byung ye shes bstan 
4b1(rgyud): pa yin||sku gsum ston pa de yi 'khor rnams la//rnam par thar pa'i lam ni rnam lnga ste//dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi lam du bstan//rang 'byung ye shes lnga yi lam lnga ni//'dod chags 
4b2(rgyud): dang ni zhe sdang gti mug dang //nga rgyal dang ni phrag dog rnam lnga ste//rang 'byung ye shes rnam lnga kun gyi lam zhes gsungs so//ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//rang 'byung ye shes lam lnga bstan pa de//rang 
4b3(rgyud): 'byung zhes ni ji ltar byung ba lags//ye shes bya ba'i bstan tshigs ci la bdags//lam zhes bgyi ba'i don ni gang la bgyi//'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang //phrag dog la sogs rnam pa lnga po de//lam lnga 
4b4(rgyud): yin pa'i don ni bshad du gsol zhes zhus so//kye sems dpa' chen po//rang 'byung ye shes rnams pa lnga lam ni//rang 'byung rgyu rkyen med par byung ba yin//ye shes 'gag pa med par gsal ba yin//lam ni rgyu rkyen 
4b5(rgyud): med pas bgrod mi dgos//mi bgrod rang 'byung lnga la lam lngar bshad//'dod pa chos rnams bdag tu 'dod pa yin//chags pa bdag tu 'dod pa de la chags//zhes rang skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la//sdang ba cho 
4b6(rgyud): 'phrul sna tshogs de la sdad//gti mug mi rtog pa yi ting 'dzin gyis//chos nyid snyam pa nyid la dbyegs la med//nga ni ma nor ba yi byang chub sems//de bzhin nyid du ye nas rgyal bar byed//thams cad de bzhin 
4b7(rgyud): nyid du gcig pa lang //yin min sgro skur 'debs la phrag dog byed//bgrod du med pa'i lam lnga bstan pa yin//kye sems dpa' chen pa nyon cig/ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun//rang 'byung ye 
4b8(rgyud): shes lam lnga 'di las byung //'dod pa'i khams kyang rang 'byung ye shes yin//gzugs kyi khams kyang rang 'byung ye shas yin//gzugs med khams kyang rang 'byung ye shis yin//kun byed rgyal po nga yis 
5a1(rgyud): @#//byas pa'i phyir//ngas byas thams cad ye shes ngo bor bshad//khams gsum sems can rgyud drug thams cad kun//rang 'byung ye shes min par ngas ma bshad//de las ma rtogs pa yi byang chub sems//
5a2(rgyud): sangs rgyas kun gyi mes po ngas ma bshad//kun byed rgyal po nga yi rang bzhin la//chos nyid rnam pa gsum du bstan pa ste//ma skyes pa yi chos nyid dngos mi snang//de ni gzugs med khams su bstan pa yin//skye 
5a3(rgyud): ba'i cho 'phrul gzugs su snang ba ni//de ni gzugs kyi khams su bstan pa yin//thugs rje ye shes ngo bo mngon phyung nas//bde sdug las de thugs rjes zad bya'i phyir//'dod pa'i khams ni thugs rjes phyung ba yin zhes
5a4(rgyud): gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos thams cad kun byed rgyal pos byas pa las ji ltar byung ba'i khungs bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems 
5a5(rgyud): kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi rang bzhin mtshan gyi chos bshad pa 'di gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khyod nyon cig/nga ni ye nas rang 'byung ye shes te//nga ni ye nas chos kun snying po yin//nga ni kun
5a6(rgyud): byed rgyal po byang chub sems//nga yi mtshan 'di sems dpa' rtogs par gyis//nga yi mtshan 'di sem dpas rtogs 'gyur na//chos rnams thams cad ma lus rtogs 'gyur gyis//nga zhes bya pa'i snying po ste//
5a7(rgyud): chos rnams kun gyi snying po yin//rang 'byung zhes ni bya ba ni//rgyu rkyen med pa'i snying po bas//rtsol sgrub kun las 'das pa yin//ye shes zhes ni bya ba ni//'gag pa med cing ma sgribs pas//chos kun ma 
5a8(rgyud): lus ston par byed//nga ni byang chub sems la bya//ye nas bya ba'i don 'di ni//thog ma nyid nas gnas pa'i don//chos kun zhes ni bya ba ni//ston pa kun kyang chos nyid la//bstan pa kun kyang chos nyid yin//
5b1(rgyud): 'khor gnas dus kyang chos nyid de//chos nyid ma yin cig kyang med//snying po bya ba 'don 'di ni//thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po ste//byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las//ston pa gsum yang de las byung //
5b2(rgyud): bstan pa gsum yang de las byug//'khor gnas dus kyang de las byung //thams cad 'byung ba'i snyeng por bshad//nga ni snying po sems nyid kyis//chos rnams ma lus kun byed de//kun zhes bya ba'i chos 
5b3(rgyud): rnams kun//chos kun gang dang gang zhe na//ston pa rang ni stan pa dang //'khor gnas dus ni thams cad kun//byed ces bya ba mkhan po ste//ston pa dang ni bstan pa dang //'khor gnam dus ni kun byed pas//rang 
5b4(rgyud): 'byung ye shes mkhan po yin//rgyal po zhes ni bya ba ni//snying po rang 'byung ye shes de//byed pa'i mkhan po kun las rgyal//chos rnams byed mkhan kun las rgyal//byed pa'i don ni 'di lta ste//snying po byang chub 
5b5(rgyud): sems de ni//rang 'byung ye nas rnam dag pas//kun byed rgyal pos byas pa kun//kun bzang nyid du rnam dag pas//byang zhes bya bar bshad pa yin//chub ces bya ba 'di lta ste//snying po rang 'byung ye shas 
5b6(rgyud): des//snang ba dang ni srid pa dang //snod dang bcud kyis bsdus pa dang //dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang //khams gsum rgyud drag sems can dang //de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la//kun 
5b7(rgyud): la rgyab ste khyab par gnas//des na chub ces bya bar bshad//sems kyi don ni 'di lta ste//snyingapo rang 'byung ye shes des//snang srid snod bcud thams cad la//'jug cing dbang sgyur gsal bar gcod//des na 
5b8(rgyud): sems zhes bya bar bshad//rgyu rkyen med pa'i snying po des//kun la dbang sgyur thams cad byed//kye sems dpa' chen po//nga yi rang bzhin rtogs gyur na//ston pa kun kyang rtogs 'gyur la//bstan pa kun kyang 
6a1(rgyud): @#//rtogs par 'gyur//'khor gyi bsam pa rig gyur la//dus gnas kun kyang gcig 'gyur rig/chos rnams thams cad nga yin pas//nga yi rang bzhin 'di rig na//chos rnams thams cad rig 'gyur 
6a2(rgyud): pas//bya byed rtsol sgrub kun las 'das//mi rtsol lhun gyis grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las nga nyid kyi mtshan bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi 
6a3(rgyud): sems kun byed rgyal pos sems dpa' rdo rje la nyid kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'i mdo 'dus pa'i don 'di bstan to//kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig/nga yi rang bzhin 'di lta ste//yod ni gcig las
6a4(rgyud): med pa ste//bstan ni rnam pa gnyis su bstan//byung ni theg pa dgu ru byung//'dus ni rdzogs pa chen por 'dus//yin ni byang chub sems yin te//gnas ni chos nyid dbyings la gnas//gsal ni rig pa mkha' 
6a5(rgyud): la gsal//khyab ni snod bcud kun la khyab//byung ni snang srid kun du byung//bstan du mtshan ma'i dngos po med//mthong du dmigs pa'i yul dang bral//shes su tshig tu brjod du med//rgyu las ma byung snying po 'di//
6a6(rgyud): sgros kyis btags pa kun dang bral//don 'di nges par rtogs 'dod na//dpe ni nam mkha' lta bur brtag/don ni chos nyid skye ba med//rtags ni sems nyid 'gag pa med//nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid la//
6a7(rgyud): nam mkha' lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon//dmigs su med pa'i chos nyid la//dmigs su med par mtshon te bstan//tshig tu rjod du med pa la//brjod du med pa'i tshig brjod de//dmigs med don kyi ngo bor bstan//
6a8(rgyud): bsdus te bstan pa'i don 'di ni//don gyi ngo bo 'grel ba ste//'di yis nga don rtogs par gyis//'di yis nga don rtogasapar byed//'di yis nga don ma rtogs na//don gyi sgra tshig ci bstan kyang//nga dang phrad par mi 'gyur 
6b1(rgyud): te||nga las kol la nga bsgribs pas//chos kyi snying po mthong mi 'gyur zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las don gyi 'grel ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems kun
6b2(rgyud): byed rgyal po des chos thams cad nyid kyi rang bzhin la rdzogs pa chen po de bstan pa'i tshig gsungs so//kye sems dpa' rdo rje tshig 'di nyon//kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni//nga yi chos rnams dang por bkod//nga yi chos rnams
6b3(rgyud): mngon du byung//nga yi ngo bo khyod la bstan//nga yi rang bzhin bstan ras ni//tshig dang sgras kyang don mtshon nas//ngo bo bstan pas khyod kyis mthong//rang bzhin bstan pas a de rig/tshig tu brjod pas don sgrar thos
6b4(rgyud): shes gsungs nas cang mi gsung bar chos thams cad kyi ngo bor bzhugs so//sems dpa' rdo rje 'khor gyi nang nas langs nas byang chub kyi sems kung byed rgyal po'i zhal du mdangs phyung ste 'khod pas kun byed rgyal
6b5(rgyud): pos||kye sems dpa' chen po khyod nga la mdangs kyis 'khod pa de khyod gyis don ci 'dod pa gsol gcig ces gsungs so//de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa//kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//
6b6(rgyud): chos rnams thams cad khyod kyi rang bzhin na//khyod kyis ston pa bstan pa 'khor bkod ci zhig lags//phun sum tshogs pa'i dgos pa ci zhig lags zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun
6b7(rgyud): byed rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po nyon gcig/chos rnams phun sum tshogs par bkod pa ni//nga nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin te//nga yi rang bzhin khyod la bstan
6b8(rgyud): par bya//nga yi rang bzhin spros bral mi phyed pas//chos dbyings gnas 'di nga yis byas pa yin//byang chub nyid las de na gzhan mi bzhugs//nga yi rang bzhin ma sgribs kun khyab pas//gsal ba'i
7a1(rgyud): @#//nam mkha' ye shes gzhal yas khang //rang 'byung ye shes nyid las gzhan mi bzhugs//de ni thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po bas//chen po lnga dang khams gsum rgyud drug rnams//nga yi sku 
7a2(rgyud): gsung thugs las gzhan med pas//nga yi rang bzhin nga yis bkod pa yin//dus gsum sangs rgyas khams gsum sems can yang //nga yi rang bzhin khyed la bstan pa yin//nga yi rang bzhin
